uncertain: Side names: the publisher calls the entrance long side "przod", the opposite long side "lewa", the terrace gable "tyl" and the blank gable "prawa", which cannot all hold geometrically. Here FRONT = entrance side, REAR = the opposite long side, LEFT = terrace gable (left hand of someone looking at the front), RIGHT = blank gable. If instead the terrace gable were taken as rear, every name would turn.
The plot plan puts the access arrow at the terrace (plan bottom) end with a path to the door on the long side; the front was still taken as the wall that holds the entrance door.
L1 is given as one opening (one frame with a transom); it could be counted as a door-high glazing plus a separate gable glazing above it.
F6 position differs between plan and elevation by about 0.45 m; the elevation was followed.
Long elevations are cut at the top edge (ridge row 0 is the picture edge) and closely cropped at the blank gable end (wall end +-4 px).
No chimney is drawn on any picture (heat pump per page text); chimneys = 0.
